title: FRICTION SHOE ASSEMBLY
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC PUGET SOUND.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PUGET SOUND
description_text: Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound (FLCPS) intends to solicit for FRICTION SHOE ASSEMBLY KITS AND COMPRESSION RINGS. The Friction Shoe Assembly Part Number is 146237H. The Compression Ring Part Number is 87X16. BRAND NAME: This requirement is BRAND NAME to EATON CORPORATION. Interested companies may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement, which will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. The determination to compete this action based upon responses received to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Government will evaluate the offerors price for reasonableness and past performance as part of the responsibility determination in accordance with RFO 12.203. Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will select the most advantageous offer based on the following evaluation factors: technical including delivery date, price, and past performance in no order of relative importance. NOTE: The customer is requesting expedited shipping on or before 1 May 2026. The expedited delivery will be the evaluation factor. Anticipated Award Date: April / 2026 Contracting Officer: Taura Helms, taura.s.helms.civ@us.navy.mil
